title: Goodest Survival PR
description: This resource pack replaces some hard-to-see block textures with more visible ones
body:
# [Goodest Survival RP] - Enhanced Visibility Resource Pack

Struggling to spot ores in dark caves or on your server? This resource pack replaces subtle block textures with **high-contrast, easily visible variants**, ensuring you never miss valuable resources again.

## Features
- **Better Visibility:** Replaces hard-to-see textures with distinct, clear alternatives.
- **Server Friendly:** Works perfectly on multiplayer servers (including modded ones like yours!).
- **Vanilla Feel:** Improves visibility without changing the core aesthetic of the game.

## Future Updates
We are constantly working to improve your experience:
- [ ] **Texture Refinements:** Further polishing of existing blocks.
- [ ] **Glow Effects:** Adding emissive properties to specific ores for dark environments.
- [ ] **Expanded Support:** Adding more block types and variations!

---
*Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.11*
